Estimated items served: beef chow mein on a plate (about 350 g), a glass of cloudy lemonade or juice (about 250 ml), and a Drumstick vanilla ice cream cone (about 100 ml, roughly 130 kcal).

Served:
- Chow mein with beef: about 350 g at roughly 1.5 kcal/g, so about 530 kcal. Macros about 20 g protein, 65 g carbs, 20 g fat.
- Lemonade: about 100 kcal, nearly all carbs (about 25 g).
- Ice cream cone: about 130 kcal. Macros about 2 g protein, 16 g carbs, 7 g fat.
- Total served: about 760 kcal.

Left over:
- Plate: only a thin residue of sauce, about 25 kcal.
- Glass: about 40% of the lemonade remains, about 40 kcal.
- Ice cream: fully eaten, wrapper left.
- Total left over: about 65 kcal.

Eaten: 760 − 65 = 695 kcal.

Macros eaten:
- Protein: about 20 g (chow mein 19 g plus ice cream 2 g, minus a little residue).
- Carbs: about 65 g from chow mein, 15 g from lemonade and 16 g from ice cream, so about 95 g.
- Fat: about 19 g from chow mein plus 7 g from ice cream, so about 26 g.
